judge.rationale: All four answers share a cytotoxic/NK core (GNLY, NKG7, GZMA/GZMB, CD8B, KLRB1/KLRF1) and a myeloid core (CST3, S100A12, FCN1, LYZ, CD14, HLA-DRB1) as lineage proxies for CD45RA, but the extensive B-cell, HLA-II, erythroid, platelet, mouse/technical, and additional effector contributors developed mainly in A and B are absent or only partly represented in C and especially D, so more than half of the complete molecular content differs and the shared-minority ceiling of 4 applies.
